# @vllnt/convex-events

> Convex component for an append-only activity feed and event log: record, list, paginate, count and purge events per subject, with optional retention.

Install `@vllnt/convex-events` (unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; `react@>=18` is optional and only
needed for `@vllnt/convex-events/react`. Mount it with `app.use(events)` from
`@vllnt/convex-events/convex.config` and call it through
`new Events<TMeta>(components.events, options?)` from host mutations and
queries. Methods: `record`, `list`, `paginate`, `count`, `purge`, `configure`,
`pruneExpired`. Feeds are keyed by an opaque `subjectRef` and ordered
newest-first by the component-stamped `createdAt`. `list` returns up to `limit`
events (default 50, max 1000) filtered by `type` and inclusive `since`;
`paginate` returns a Convex cursor page; `count` reads at most `maxCount + 1`
rows (default and max 1000) and returns `{ count, isExact }`. `record` accepts
`actorRef`, typed `metadata` and an `idempotencyKey` (1..256 characters, per
subject) that returns the first event's id on a retry. `purge` deletes a
subject's events (optionally `createdAt < before`) in self-rescheduling batches
(default 256, max 500). Retention is off until `configure(ctx, retentionMs)`;
then a daily cron prunes events older than the window. Invalid input throws
`ConvexError` with `data.code` `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`,
`INVALID_LIMIT`, `INVALID_SINCE`, `INVALID_BATCH`, `INVALID_BEFORE` or
`INVALID_RETENTION`. Optional client guards (`allowedTypes`, `maxTypeLength`,
`maxMetadataBytes`, `metadataValidator`) throw `EventValidationError` with
`code` `EVENTS_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED`, `EVENTS_TYPE_TOO_LONG`,
`EVENTS_METADATA_INVALID` or `EVENTS_METADATA_TOO_LARGE`. React hooks
`useActivityFeed` and `useEventCount` take the host's own public queries. The
host owns auth and the meaning of subjects, actors, types and metadata.

## When to use

- Use it when you need a newest-first history of what happened to one subject
  (a user, document, order or project).
- Use it when events must be appended, never edited, and read back by type,
  time or cursor page.
- Use it when retries must not write the same event twice (`idempotencyKey`).
- Do not use it when each recipient needs an inbox with read/unread state: use
  `@vllnt/convex-notifications`.
- Do not use it when you need aggregate metrics such as funnels, retention or
  uniques: use `@vllnt/convex-analytics`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-events/docs/`
and match the installed version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before
writing code. The links below to `./` paths are files inside the installed package.

- [README](./README.md): Install, quick start, common tasks, limits
